_schema.description: Snapshot of every ACTIVE ButterLu Etsy listing via Etsy Open API v3 (x-api-key only, read-only). Produced by scripts/etsy-export-listings.mjs. The new catalog is built from this. Descriptions are NOT stored, only length and sha256. Image URLs only, nothing downloaded.

row.title: string
row.url: string — etsy.com listing URL, query string stripped
row.price: number — minimum price across variations; exact per-offering prices need the inventory endpoint
row.taxonomyPath: string | null — seller taxonomy, "A > B > C"
row.personalizationCharCountMax: integer | null — largest max_allowed_characters across text questions

personalizationQuestions.instructions: string | null

row.variations: null — getListingInventory needs OAuth scope listings_r, see variationsStatus
row.views: integer — Etsy tabulates daily, lifetime count

images.alt: string | null

variationsStatus: skipped: GET /v3/application/listings/{listing_id}/inventory returns 401 "Access token is required for this request (requires scope: listings_r)" with x-api-key alone. Needs the OAuth flow.
